title: Project update cards in the Discover feed
summary: Adds paged, filtered project-update cards to the Discover feed and an in-place thread, read through two rate-limited GET routes that apply the project page's own visibility rules (project visibility and status, hidden Updates tab, blocks, private-author masking). Adds a feed index on project_updates and keeps e2e fixture accounts out of the People rail.
concurrencyRisk: Low. Reads are keyset-paged and uncached per viewer, so like state cannot leak between viewers. The like and comment caches are patched optimistically and reconciled with the server's answer; a failure restores the exact earlier cache state.

rollback.strategy: Remove the update branch from DiscoverClient (feed items become projects only) and delete the /api/v1/discover/updates routes. The index in 0242 is additive and can stay or be dropped with DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY project_updates_discover_feed_idx.
